narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Any order of the letters will do, because all four letters are there.
<bookmark mark='jump'/>Try the name eigh, bee, dee, cee. It jumps from bee straight across the middle to dee.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>A line that joins two opposite corners is called a diagonal, and a diagonal is not a side.
